NEW: Forensic expert Professor Michael Freeman says Jeffrey Epstein was murdered rather than dying by suicide in his New York prison cell in August 2019.
Freeman said his review of autopsy records and photographs suggested Epstein was strangled, most likely from behind, before his body was suspended from a bunk bed.
"The injuries and the way the body was found don't match up. There's only one remaining explanation then, and that is that the death was as a result of a homicide," he said.
Freeman, who did not examine the body, said he had "no idea" who might have killed Epstein.

Forensic expert Professor Michael Freeman:
Jeffrey Epstein didn't get all of those injuries from self-inflicted hanging. The hanging alone cannot explain the injuries. 
By a process of elimination, he didn't die from a natural cause. He didn't die from old age in his cell, and he didn't die from an accident.

Germany, the Netherlands, Greece, Austria and Denmark have agreed to establish an EU migrant deportation center in Rwanda in 2027.
The facility will hold rejected asylum seekers awaiting return to their home countries.
Austrian Chancellor Stocker hailed the deal as “historic,” while the EU rights agency urged legal safeguards.
Source: Bloomberg
